LanguageData.TM_ReservoirFuelReserveDesc: Protect a fixed quantity of fuel from ordinary consumers, conversion and rituals. Flight and life support may spend it. Life support can empty this reserve, so it does not guarantee a return trip. Mana produced by permitted life-support conversion is shared normally.
